text:
Maya: Heads-up — the QuickPlay microkit (Next + LangChain RAG example) is hitting auth/retry oddness when run with SDK v0.9 on local dev. Auth token rotates, then we get duplicate requests and the eval harness marks examples as flaky.
Kevin: repro steps?
Maya: clone repo, npm i, set REDWOOD_API_KEY env, run `npm run dev`, then trigger `/api/qa` route that uses streaming with `client.chat.stream`. After token rotation we see 401 then immediate retry and another 401, but logs show two generation attempts and billing shows two short inference calls.
Kevin: can you paste the exact log snippet?
Maya: sure —

```
[12:02:11] auth: token refresh succeeded
[12:02:12] request: /v1/chat (id=abc123) -> 401
[12:02:12] retry: attempt 1 for id=abc123
[12:02:12] request: /v1/chat (id=abc123) -> 401
[12:02:12] client: streaming closed, partial output flushed
```

Sasha: that looks like the client retries synchronously without waiting for token refresh to finish?
Maya: yup — the token refresh race wins but the retry logic fires first. On hosted we have fallback policies so apps survive, but local eval harness flags the result as non-deterministic.
Kevin: which SDK call stack? is this the browser SDK or node?
Maya: node dev server (Next API route). Using `@redwood/sdk` v0.9.0. We didn't see this with v0.10 alpha.
Jin: probable cause: v0.9 retry middleware checks status and enqueues retry immediately; v0.10 added a short jitter/wait for auth refresh. Can you try disabling automatic retries as a workaround? e.g., `new RedwoodClient({ retry: { maxRetries: 0 } })`
Maya: disabling retries avoids double billing but breaks resilience for transient errors. For the eval harness we attempted to patch by adding `await sleep(200)` after token rotation, which is gross.
devex-bot: Suggested docs update: add note about token rotation + local dev with streaming — link-to-issue #4281
Sasha: action items: 1) add test in integration suite simulating token rotation + streaming 2) add quickfix to microkit README about setting retry=0 for local runs 3) Jin to propose a small backport to v0.9 middleware.
Jin: I'll open a PR for the middleware tweak — will try to make it a non-breaking opt-in flag. Assigning to myself.
Maya: thanks — also, can we add a minimal repro script in the sample that toggles token rotation so new devs can hit it quickly? saves time in support.
Kevin: agree. add a small `scripts/repro-rotate.js` and a note in README. Keep it flagged as "dev-only".
Sasha: for the eval harness: recommend we run harness under `RETRY=0` config to avoid flakiness until middleware backport lands.
Maya: filing a short PR to update the microkit README now. ping me on the PR for review. :thumbsup:
Jin: PR for middleware coming shortly — reference this thread and link the repro script.
Kevin: thx all — moving this to `triage:devex` and adding to next sprint.
Maya: awesome, closing loop for now.
